headline: Linn Mercy Front Reopens as Weathered Expanse Rages
war_summary: The chief change since our last edition is the reopening of the Linn Mercy front, where thirteen flag actions in a day — five falling within two hours of press time — have kept Outwich Ranch and Lathair in constant contention, leaving the count at eight Colonial posts against two Warden with one ground in ruin. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's furnace: fifty-one flag movements in twenty-four hours, with Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Wightwalk each changing hands repeatedly, yet the tally holds at six Warden holdings, one Colonial and two ruins, the last movement logged minutes before this edition went to press. Kuura Strand has stirred anew, Talven and Faden Point turning and turning back, all six bases still flying Colonial colors. Mooring County's lone Colonial toehold at The Wind Hills endures, and the Nevish Line, silent on flags for some seven hours, continues to exact a fearful toll, its casualty rolls rivalled only by Callahans Passage, where the grind is heaviest of all though no ground has shifted. Marban Hollow and Stlican Shelf have gone quiet, and minor tremors at Argosa and Transient Valley warrant little note. It is day 715; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is declared.
